mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COURSE WHERE STATUS = 'Y'

SELECT COURSE_ID AS courseId, COURSE_TITLE AS courseTitle, DESCRIPTION AS description, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, STATUS AS status, START_DATE AS startDate, END_DATE AS endDate, TOTAL_HOURS AS totalHours, CREATE_DATE AS createDate, UPDATED_DATE AS updatedDate FROM COURSE
( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COURSE_TARGET CT_MATCH WHERE CT_MATCH.COURSE_ID = COURSE.COURSE_ID AND ( ( UPPER(CT_MATCH.TARGET_TYPE) IN ('DEPT', 'DEPARTMENT', '부서') AND CT_MATCH.TARGET_VALUE = #{departmentId} ) OR ( UPPER(CT_MATCH.TARGET_TYPE) IN ('POS', 'POSITION', '직급') AND CT_MATCH.TARGET_VALUE = #{positionId} ) ) ) OR ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COURSE_TARGET CT_SPEC WHERE CT_SPEC.COURSE_ID = COURSE.COURSE_ID AND UPPER(CT_SPEC.TARGET_TYPE) IN ('DEPT', 'DEPARTMENT', '부서', 'POS', 'POSITION', '직급') ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COURSE_TARGET CT_ALL WHERE CT_ALL.COURSE_ID = COURSE.COURSE_ID AND UPPER(CT_ALL.TARGET_TYPE) IN ('ALL', '전체') ) ) )
AND ( COURSE_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY STATUS DESC, CREATE_DATE ASC
ORDER BY STATUS DESC, CREATE_DATE DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COURSE(COURSE_ID, COURSE_TITLE, DESCRIPTION, MEMBER_ID, STATUS, START_DATE, END_DATE, TOTAL_HOURS, CREATE_DATE, UPDATED_DATE) VALUES (SEQ_CNO.NEXTVAL + 80, #{courseTitle}, #{description}, #{memberId}, 'W', #{startDate}, #{endDate}, 0, SYSDATE, NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT C.COURSE_ID AS courseId, C.COURSE_TITLE AS courseTitle, C.DESCRIPTION AS description, M.NAME AS name, C.STATUS AS status, C.START_DATE AS startDate, C.END_DATE AS endDate, C.TOTAL_HOURS AS totalHours, C.CREATE_DATE AS createDate, C.UPDATED_DATE AS updatedDate, M.MEMBER_ID AS memberId FROM COURSE C, MEMBER M WHERE C.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID AND COURSE_ID = #{courseId}

mapper.update: UPDATE COURSE SET COURSE_TITLE = #{courseTitle}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, START_DATE = #{startDate}, END_DATE = #{endDate}, UPDATED_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND COURSE_ID = #{courseId}

UPDATE COURSE C SET C.TOTAL_HOURS = ( SELECT NVL(ROUND(SUM(NVL(A.VIDEO_DURATION, 0)) / 3600), 0) FROM CHAPTER CH LEFT JOIN ATTACHMENT A ON A.FILE_ID = CH.VIDEO_FILE_ID WHERE CH.COURSE_ID = C.COURSE_ID ) WHERE C.COURSE_ID = #{courseId}
